consumers.name: worker_subprocess
consumers.semantics: Unknown fields fail; successful process exit is insufficient. Check embedded error and completed iterations.

consumers.name: report_envelope
consumers.semantics: engine is currently wowsims-forever, summary field names are PascalCase. A future Rust adapter must retain compatibility or explicitly version the parser. Never overwrite stored historical identities.

consumers.name: headline_and_confidence
consumers.semantics: API computes mean standard error as stdev/sqrt(iterations)/mean. Duration is measured mean fight time, not configured 120. Zero-valued proto fields can be omitted.

consumers.name: actions_and_breakdown
consumers.semantics: Action totals span all fights; aura uptime is already mean seconds per fight. Divide damage by iterations times average duration. Filter self damage from DPS, preserve resource overcap and separate channel from tick IDs. Preserve tags, enemy unit indices and zero/omitted fields.

consumers.name: settings_and_rotation_card
consumers.semantics: API prefers effectiveRotation, falls back to input. rotationStats missing means unvalidated; current observed Go reference omits both. Do not fabricate validation success.

consumers.name: timelines_and_log
consumers.semantics: First fight comes from debugFirstIteration. Worker normally runs a separate 100-fight seed7 debug request for averaged timeline. Logs are extracted from result and stored as a separate artifact. Only first-fight timeline is frozen in piece1.

consumers.name: talent_card
consumers.semantics: Display from actual mapped request and catalog, preserve original character metadata.

consumers.name: stat_weights
consumers.semantics: 12 configured Mage stats, SpellDamage EP reference. Multiple perturbed requests must use one engine/reference for the whole job.

consumers.name: gear_batches
consumers.semantics: Best Gear/trinket comparisons can change effects, gear and enchants. Full comparison stays Go until every candidate is covered.

consumers.name: rankings_and_lab
consumers.semantics: Public ranking and lab jobs need their own versioned scenario and release validation. This inventory does not enable them or refresh boards.

known_gaps.decision: Open correctness question. The app warns that Go does not spend a FoF charge for Arcane Missiles and DPS may be overstated. Preserve warnings and review live evidence before an intentional divergence.
known_gaps.name: fof_channel_consumption

known_gaps.decision: Go hardcodes proc chances, duration and tick-speed effect because generated client rows are missing. Compatibility evidence only.
known_gaps.name: missile_barrage_assumptions

known_gaps.decision: Go uses 0.143 from preliminary beta log reasoning despite client coefficient zero. Carry uncertainty into the mechanics ledger.
known_gaps.name: ice_lance_coefficient

known_gaps.decision: Carved Mind 1302342 exists in item data but its Go proc registration is commented out. Initial Go compatibility does not establish full in-game item support.
known_gaps.name: mind_carver_effect

known_gaps.decision: Synthetic reference has no addon talent spell IDs; mapping is pinned and the app emits a warning. General identity mapping remains separate work.
known_gaps.name: positional_talent_export

known_gaps.decision: Ice Block and Ice Barrier are selected but modeled as no-ops by Go. This scope is outgoing single-player damage without Mage incoming damage or pets.
known_gaps.name: defensive_talent_noops

mechanics.name: real_character_preparation
mechanics.requirement: Human base stats and Spirit multiplier, Engineering, equipped stats, static enchant effects, selected talents and raid assumptions. Apply each modifier exactly once.

mechanics.name: frostbolt
mechanics.requirement: 25304 cast, GCD, travel, binary hit/resist, damage and crit, mana and triggers. Existing kernel covers isolated prepared casting only.

mechanics.name: ice_lance
mechanics.requirement: 1240047 instant cast, travel, binary hit/resist, frozen damage multiplier and charge consumption.

mechanics.name: arcane_missiles
mechanics.requirement: 25345 channel and 25346 separate damage ticks, haste/channel-length modifiers, travel, partial resistance, hit/crit, channel lifetime and proc callbacks.

mechanics.name: proc_lifecycle
mechanics.requirement: Clearcasting 12536, Missile Barrage 44404, Fingers of Frost 400669 and Winter's Chill 12579: durations, stacks, ICDs, trigger order and cast snapshots.

mechanics.name: mana_recovery
mechanics.requirement: Mana Ruby 8008 and registered lower gems 8007/5513/5514; Demonic Rune 12662 shares conjured cooldown. Major Mana Potion 13444 and Robe 14152 use activation predicates and own/shared timers.

mechanics.name: evocation
mechanics.requirement: 12051 channel and spirit-regeneration modifier. Present in rotation although not exercised in this 3000-fight observation.

mechanics.name: cold_snap
mechanics.requirement: 12472 executes via autocastOtherCooldowns, resets Frost spell cooldowns, no GCD or cast-complete hook.

mechanics.name: raid_assumptions
mechanics.requirement: Mage Armor, Kings, Wisdom, Arcane Brilliance, Spirit, Gift, Moonkin, Mana Spring, Curse of Elements and Judgement of Wisdom; mana, spell damage, hit/crit and resistance effects.

mechanics.name: static_consumables
mechanics.requirement: Flask 13512, food 18254, oil 20749, Mageblood 20007, Frost Power 17708, Greater Arcane 13454, Cerebral Cortex 8423.

mechanics.name: rotation_interpreter
mechanics.requirement: Ordered six-action TypeAPL; castSpell, autocastOtherCooldowns, cmp OpLe/OpLt/OpGt, and, const percent/time, currentManaPercent, remainingTime, auraIsKnown, auraIsActive. Re-evaluate at correct decision times.

mechanics.name: fight_and_reporting
mechanics.requirement: 120 +/- 15 seconds, 20-yard travel, level63 target, seed42 as protojson string, 3000 fights, metrics plus first-fight and averaged timelines. The misleading target name is display metadata.
